sloka: तत: श्वशुरमामन्त्र्य वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम् ।मम पित्रा त्वहं दत्ता रामाय विदितात्मने ॥ २.११८.५२॥
transliteration: tata: śvaśuramāmantrya vṛddhaṁ daśarathaṁ nṛpam ।mama pitrā tvahaṁ dattā rāmāya viditātmane ॥ 2.118.52॥

translations.english: Thereafter, my fatherinlaw, the aged king Dasaratha was invited and my father offered me to Rama known for his sagacity.
